frequency_question: What proportion of expiring transboundary water treaties successfully secure a renewal or successor agreement within the designated expiration window?
membership_rule: Includes formal bilateral or multilateral water allocation treaties that reached a defined expiration or renewal milestone; excludes purely domestic water disputes or informal arrangements without treaty status.
window: A 5-year window around the expiration date (3 years prior to 2 years post)

cases.name: 1995 Mekong Agreement successor to 1957 Mekong Committee

provenance_note: 6 cases named, 7 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.2x)
coverage_note: 6 named; believed roughly 7 in total for major foundational bilateral water treaties
known_gaps: Historical data on smaller, less publicized regional treaties is sparse.
skeleton: 6 historical transboundary water treaty renegotiation milestones
multiplier: 6 hits out of 7 major comparable historical renewal processes
validity_reason: International legal norms regarding water security and riparian cooperation evolve slowly over decades.
